checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=38 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.6 tightness=0.95 base_volume_vs_leg=0.82 base_volume_vs_avg=0.92
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 38 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; the base gave back 0.6 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 1.9% vs its 20-SMA, -0.3% over 20 sessions

claude.reason: The base is 38 sessions long — nearly double Bonde's 20-session ceiling — and gave back 60% of the prior leg, both recorded FAILs that signal a loose, extended consolidation rather than a tight pause. Visually the shaded box confirms a wide, multi-month range with overlapping bars and declining price action from the August highs toward the September lows, consistent with a base that is really a downtrend with a bounce. Volume on the burst day is below the 50-session average (0.93x) and ranks only 23rd of the last 60 sessions, failing the catalyst-volume requirement that applies to any base over 21 sessions.
claude.key_risk: The 38-session base gave back 60% of the leg and volume is well below the required 1.5x average, meaning there is no evidence of institutional accumulation driving this move.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the burst-day close (~229.67) or if volume in the first 30 minutes is tracking below average pace.
